invariants.rationale: GDX Scene2d APIs expect 'Batch' objects to be non-null when 'draw' is called.
Alpha blending factors in GDX are typically in [0,1] range, and draw(float) usually expects valid alpha values.
The 'label' field is assumed initialized as it is dereferenced in this method.
The method accesses 'label.getStyle()', so it should not be null.
The method sets 'label.getStyle().fontColor = getFontColor();', so they should be equal upon method exit.
